description: This Java class 'DeviceListActivity' is an Android activity that displays a list of paired and discoverable Bluetooth devices, allowing the user to select a device and returning its MAC address.

classes.name: DeviceListActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that lists Bluetooth devices (paired and discovered) and returns the selected device's MAC address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, registers broadcast receivers, and populates the list with paired devices.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by canceling discovery and unregistering receivers.

methods.name: doDiscovery
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth device discovery, updates UI to indicate scanning.
